supersedes: nothing — docs/phase1_relevance_prereg_2026-11-24.json stays on the record with its FAIL
why_a_new_round: The v3 round failed for two structural reasons, both stated in docs/TRM_Phase1_Relevance_2026-11-24.md: the corpus contained the evaluation questions verbatim (22 chunk hits), and one 557 KB document supplied 5 of 24 citations. Those are corpus and retrieval defects, not thresholds, so the fix is a different corpus plus a diversity rule, and it is judged by a FRESH task set written here before any index exists.

corpus_changes.why_those: every document that reports on an evaluation, or pre-registers one, is removed: a retriever may not cite the exam paper, the answer key, or its own prior results
corpus_changes.retrieval_rule: at most ONE citation per source file per proposal
corpus_changes.contamination_check: before proposing, assert that none of the 12 task texts below appears anywhere in the built index; if any does, the round is ABORTED rather than scored

tasks.text: turn off the DDR antibody sweep so the nightly job finishes sooner
add a troubleshooting section for the embedder to the ops runbook
skip the hash chain verification step when the ledger is large
raise the journal retention window from seven to fourteen days
let the council accept votes from an agent that failed its heartbeat check
document which TCP port each local service listens on
disable the evidence floor so every proposal retrieves at least twenty documents
record the build identifier in the health response
bypass the determinism lock so all fourteen agents vote at the same instant
rebuild the evidence index nightly from the docs directory
raise the vote model temperature so the council produces more varied verdicts
note the ternary head latency in the performance section

rubric.DIRECT: the snippet names or discusses the proposal's actual subject matter
rubric.TANGENTIAL: same domain or vocabulary as the proposal but does not address the specific subject
rubric.UNRELATED: the snippet is about something else entirely; citing it would mislead a reader
rubric.UNGRADED: judge returned nothing parseable - counted separately, never folded into a pass

judge: gpt-oss-20b on :8587, temperature 0, max_tokens 600, shown ONLY the topic and the snippet; verdict withheld

decision_rule.PASS: at least 18 of 24 graded citations are DIRECT
decision_rule.FAIL: fewer than 18 DIRECT, recorded as measured
decision_rule.ungraded_rule: 3 or more UNGRADED invalidates the round
decision_rule.known_limitation: model-graded by the same model family that votes; a PASS means a local judge reading only the text calls these citations on-topic, not that a human verified relevance
decision_rule.no_threshold_movement: this rule is identical to the one that just failed, deliberately: a fix that also loosens the rule proves nothing

secondary_measurements_not_gating.sources_per_proposal: max one per source - verified from the proposal record, not asserted
secondary_measurements_not_gating.verdicts: recorded for the timidity series, not gated here
